integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, nature documentary footage. Deep underwater, darkness except for a faint blue glow. The camera tracks the moving subject at slow speed. A siphonophore drifts into the beam of a submersible's searchlight, marine snow falling around it. The narrator with a calm, low British male voice (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] At this depth, sunlight is only a rumour.</d> while their lips remain completely closed. [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the siphonophore as faint blue and violet light pulses slowly along its body. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. The narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] And yet, the siphonophore makes its own.</d> while their lips remain completely closed.

overall_soundscape: A sonar ping repeats and the submersible's motors hum low. A muffled, slow pulse throbs like a heartbeat.

non_diegetic_music: A sustained analog synth pad at a slow tempo, very quiet, with a deep bass note entering halfway.
